note: Machine-readable source of truth for playful's component class strings, validated against designs/playful/index.html by scripts/check.mjs. Rounded-xl and bouncy like learn, but with single-weight borders on surfaces and a plain accent-filled active nav item. Fields are border-2 with a soft focus:ring-4 halo, and form controls are styled native inputs (peer/checked:). Values are Tailwind utility classes routed through the tokens in shared/TOKENS.md.

button.docs: Rounded-xl, font-semibold. default/destructive use transition-all so their shadow lifts on hover. sm tightens the radius to rounded-lg. link is padding/height-less (cn()/tailwind-merge drops the size padding).
